title: Argentinian Masarepa Toast
description: A quick and easy Argentinian breakfast dish featuring crispy toast topped with a rich and resinous masarepa mixture.
instructions: Toast 2 slices of bread until crispy.
In a medium saucepan, melt 2 tablespoons of butter over low heat.
Add 1 cup of masarepa to the saucepan and stir until well combined with the melted butter.
Cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly, until the masarepa mixture is slightly browned and fragrant.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and stir in 1/2 cup of shredded cheddar cheese until melted.
Season the masarepa mixture with salt and black pepper to taste.
Place the toasted bread slices on a serving plate and top each slice with a generous spoonful of the masarepa mixture.
